article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 15 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Captain America Origins, Spike Jones WWII Satire, and The Light Crust Doughboys
article-meta.kwd-group: Captain America, Red Skull, Marvel Comics, Light Crust Doughboys, Western Swing, Spike Jones, Der Fuehrers Face, Dame Vera Lynn, Francis the Talking Mule, ZaSu Pitts, Bill Stern, 1947 World Series, Marie McDonald, Cliff Edwards, Ukulele Ike, Red Skelton, Freddy Martin, Spotlight Bands, Country Style USA, Hartz Mountain Canaries, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 101 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 101 recovers and dates 15 extraordinary historical broadcasts spanning Marvel audio drama, wartime satirical musical comedy, western swing pioneers, Hollywood comedy trailers, sportscasting legends, vaudeville vocalists, and novelty radio broadcasts: 2 landmark 1975 audio dramas dramatizing the comic book origin of Captain America and his arch-nemesis the Red Skull, 3 rare transcription tracks from pioneering Texas western swing group ***The Light Crust Doughboys*** (1939), Spike Jones and His City Slickers' famous 1942 wartime anti-fascist satire 'Der Fuehrer's Face', Dame Vera Lynn singing the wartime classic 'When the Lights Go On Again' (1942), Universal's original 1950 radio promotional feature for *Francis the Talking Mule* starring comedic legend ZaSu Pitts, Bill Stern's sports newsreels covering the 1947 Yankees-Dodgers World Series and interviewing Hollywood starlet Marie McDonald, Cliff 'Ukulele Ike' Edwards singing his signature 'Yes Sir, That's My Baby' (1944), Red Skelton ushering in the 1952 New Year, and Freddy Martin and His Orchestra on ***Spotlight Bands*** (1943).

sec.title: 1. *Captain America: Audio Origins* & *The Light Crust Doughboys*
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Pop Culture & Music Context | |---|---|---|---| | `Captain_America_Origin.mp3` | **"Captain America: 'The Origin of Captain America - Super Soldier Serum'"** | **1975-04-12** | Steve Rogers taking Dr. Erskine's super soldier serum to fight WWII Axis agents. | | `Captain_America_Red_Skull.mp3` | **"Captain America: 'The Origin of the Red Skull - Axis Menace'"** | **1975-04-19** | The dramatic audio origin of Johann Schmidt as the dreaded Red Skull. | | `Light_Crust_Mama_Wants.mp3` | **"The Light Crust Doughboys: 'Mama Gets What She Wants' & Western Swing"** | **1939-06-15** | Texas western swing fiddle and acoustic guitar rhythms sponsored by Burrus Mill. | | `Light_Crust_Smokey_Joe.mp3` | **"The Light Crust Doughboys: 'Smokey Joe from El Paso'"** | **1939-06-22** | Fast-paced western swing novelty tune from Fort Worth, Texas. | | `Light_Crust_One_Time_Too_Many.mp3` | **"The Light Crust Doughboys: 'One Time Too Many'"** | **1939-06-29** | Traditional western string band vocal harmonies and twin fiddles. |
